finding: The trigger, the folder and the file read work. The run stops at the per-file sharing link: the shareV2 call (type Edit, scope Anonymous, ITEM-73) must give the file its own permissions, and the registry OneDrive's document library has reached SharePoint's limit on separately shared items. No other adopted flow creates sharing links, so the shared items were created outside the platform. Any per-file link (Anonymous or Organization) needs the same new permission, so changing the link scope alone does not fix it.
